claims.evidence: Witness report shows two PS4-style controllers and a box with 'STAR WARS' and 'PS4' text; no PS4 Pro console is shown.
No console performance details or gameplay evidence shown.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating
claims.evidence: No console or internal condition is shown; only controllers/cables/box text are described.
No ports are shown being tested; witness only notes cables and controllers.
Witness cannot confirm original vs compatible/clone; branding/model details are not readable.
No receipt is shown in the witness observations.

risks.risk: Controllers may be compatible/clone rather than original DualShock/PS4 pads (affects reliability and resale value).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the controller backs and labels/markings (e.g., Sony/DUALSHOCK branding, model/CUH/serial text) plus a screenshot/video of PS4 recognizing them as the correct controller model.
risks.if_unproven: Price as compatible/unknown controllers (worst case: not original).

risks.risk: Controller condition issues: stick drift, unresponsive buttons, worn triggers, or cable damage.
risks.proof: Short video clip showing: analog stick movement in all directions without drift, button presses responding on-screen, trigger/shoulder buttons working, and cable/connection stability while moving the cable.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'untested/possible faults' (worst case: may need repair or replacement).

risks.risk: Controllers may not fully work or may not be paired/recognized by a PS4.
risks.proof: Video/screenshot of PS4 'Settings > Devices > Controllers' showing both controllers connected and responding to inputs.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'may not pair/partially working' (worst case: one controller not usable).

risks.risk: The box text ('STAR WARS' and 'PS4') may not match the actual contents (e.g., not a genuine bundle or missing items).
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (controllers, both cables, any manuals/extra accessories) with a checklist against what the seller claims.
risks.if_unproven: Price for only what is clearly visible: two controllers and the cables (worst case: missing claimed extras).

risks.risk: Seller may be mixing items (claiming PS4 Pro/console) while the visible item is only controllers.
risks.proof: Photo of the actual console (front/back/model label) if it exists, or a clear statement and photo that only controllers are being sold.
risks.if_unproven: Price as controllers-only (worst case: no console included).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photos of each controller’s back label/model/serial markings (to confirm original vs compatible).
Video showing both controllers connected to a PS4 and responding to inputs (sticks, D-pad, face buttons, triggers/shoulders).
Video showing no stick drift (calibration/inputs stable) and that cables/ports hold connection while gently moving the cables.
Photos of the full bundle laid out (confirm exactly what accessories are included).
If claiming PS4 Pro: photos of the console itself (front/back) and the model label; otherwise confirm the sale is only for controllers.
response.reason: The witness can identify PS4-style controllers and a 'STAR WARS/PS4' box, but cannot confirm originality, working condition, pairing, or whether the claimed PS4 Pro/receipt are actually included. Missing proof prevents a safe worst-case price.
